section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section defines subjective well-being, gratitude, and loneliness, discussing their components and significance in mental health. It reviews existing literature on the relationships between these constructs, highlighting gratitude's role as a predictor of well-being and a protective factor against loneliness. The section concludes by stating the main aim of 'this research' is to examine the roles of loneliness and gratitude in subjective well-being, building upon previous studies.
